//go:build windows

package windows

import (
	"encoding/binary"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"slices"
	"sync"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/codetreker/remote-fs/packages/smb/internal/wire"
)

type preciseQFid struct {
	Raw              string
	DiskID, VolumeID uint64
	Reserved         string
}
type preciseFileIdentity struct {
	Class       byte
	RawIdentity string
	InternalID  *uint64
	VolumeID    *uint64
	ID128       string
}
type preciseIdentityRecord struct {
	Sequence                                   uint64
	At                                         time.Time
	Connection, Session, RawSession, MessageID uint64
	Command                                    uint16
	Response                                   bool
	Status                                     uint32
	FileID                                     string
	RelatedCreate                              uint64
	QueryType, QueryClass                      byte
	ContextsChecked                            bool
	ContextNames                               []string
	QFidRequested                              bool
	QFid                                       *preciseQFid
	FileIdentity                               *preciseFileIdentity
	VolumeSerial                               *uint32
	Complete                                   bool
	Error                                      string
}

var preciseIdentityRegistry struct {
	sync.Mutex
	records      []preciseIdentityRecord
	pending      map[parentNotifyKey]preciseIdentityRecord
	bytes        int
	failure      error
	firstOpenEnd uint64
}

const preciseIdentityRecords = 64
const preciseIdentityBytes = 64 << 10

func preciseIdentityReset() {
	preciseIdentityRegistry.Lock()
	defer preciseIdentityRegistry.Unlock()
	preciseIdentityRegistry.records = nil
	preciseIdentityRegistry.pending = make(map[parentNotifyKey]preciseIdentityRecord)
	preciseIdentityRegistry.bytes = 0
	preciseIdentityRegistry.failure = nil
	preciseIdentityRegistry.firstOpenEnd = 0
}
func preciseIdentitySnapshot() ([]preciseIdentityRecord, error) {
	preciseIdentityRegistry.Lock()
	defer preciseIdentityRegistry.Unlock()
	err := preciseIdentityRegistry.failure
	if len(preciseIdentityRegistry.pending) != 0 {
		err = errors.Join(err, errors.New("identity evidence has unmatched requests"))
	}
	return slices.Clone(preciseIdentityRegistry.records), err
}
func preciseIdentitySelected(r cacheGatePositiveWireRecord) bool {
	return r.Command == wire.Create || r.Command == wire.QueryInfo && (r.QueryType == 1 && (r.QueryClass == 6 || r.QueryClass == 18 || r.QueryClass == 59) || r.QueryType == 2 && r.QueryClass == 1)
}
func preciseIdentityFields(packet []byte, r cacheGatePositiveWireRecord) (preciseIdentityRecord, error) {
	out := preciseIdentityRecord{At: time.Now(), Connection: r.Connection, Session: r.SessionID, RawSession: r.SessionID, MessageID: r.MessageID, Command: r.Command, Response: r.Response, Status: r.Status, FileID: r.FileID, RelatedCreate: r.RelatedCreate, QueryType: r.QueryType, QueryClass: r.QueryClass}
	if len(packet) < wire.HeaderSize+8 || r.Connection == 0 || r.SessionID == 0 || r.Incomplete != "" {
		return out, errors.New("identity packet or correlation is incomplete")
	}
	if r.Response && r.Status != 0 {
		out.Complete = true
		return out, nil
	}
	body := packet[wire.HeaderSize:]
	le := binary.LittleEndian
	if r.Command == wire.Create {
		var offset, length uint32
		minimum := 120
		if r.Response {
			if !cacheGatePositiveFixed(body, 89, 88) {
				return out, errors.New("identity CREATE response is truncated")
			}
			offset, length = le.Uint32(body[80:84]), le.Uint32(body[84:88])
			minimum = 152
		} else {
			if !cacheGatePositiveFixed(body, 57, 56) {
				return out, errors.New("identity CREATE request is truncated")
			}
			offset, length = le.Uint32(body[48:52]), le.Uint32(body[52:56])
		}
		if err := preciseIdentityContexts(packet, offset, length, minimum, &out); err != nil {
			return out, err
		}
		out.ContextsChecked = true
	} else if r.Response {
		if !cacheGatePositiveFixed(body, 9, 8) {
			return out, errors.New("identity QUERY_INFO response is truncated")
		}
		data, ok := cacheGatePositiveField(packet, uint32(le.Uint16(body[2:4])), le.Uint32(body[4:8]), 72)
		if !ok {
			return out, errors.New("identity QUERY_INFO data span is invalid")
		}
		switch {
		case r.QueryType == 1 && r.QueryClass == 6:
			if len(data) != 8 {
				return out, errors.New("internal identity length is invalid")
			}
			id := le.Uint64(data)
			out.FileIdentity = &preciseFileIdentity{Class: 6, RawIdentity: hex.EncodeToString(data), InternalID: &id}
		case r.QueryType == 1 && r.QueryClass == 18:
			if len(data) < 100 || uint64(le.Uint32(data[96:100])) != uint64(len(data)-100) || le.Uint32(data[96:100])&1 != 0 {
				return out, errors.New("all-information identity or name length is invalid")
			}
			id := le.Uint64(data[64:72])
			out.FileIdentity = &preciseFileIdentity{Class: 18, RawIdentity: hex.EncodeToString(data[64:72]), InternalID: &id}
		case r.QueryType == 1 && r.QueryClass == 59:
			if len(data) != 24 {
				return out, errors.New("128-bit identity length is invalid")
			}
			volume := le.Uint64(data)
			out.FileIdentity = &preciseFileIdentity{Class: 59, RawIdentity: hex.EncodeToString(data), VolumeID: &volume, ID128: hex.EncodeToString(data[8:])}
		case r.QueryType == 2 && r.QueryClass == 1:
			if len(data) < 18 || uint64(le.Uint32(data[12:16])) != uint64(len(data)-18) || le.Uint32(data[12:16])&1 != 0 {
				return out, errors.New("filesystem volume serial framing is invalid")
			}
			serial := le.Uint32(data[8:12])
			out.VolumeSerial = &serial
		default:
			return out, errors.New("unexpected selected identity class")
		}
	}
	out.Complete = true
	return out, nil
}

func preciseIdentityContexts(packet []byte, offset, length uint32, minimum int, out *preciseIdentityRecord) error {
	data, ok := cacheGatePositiveField(packet, offset, length, minimum)
	if !ok || len(data) > 0 && offset&7 != 0 {
		return errors.New("identity context span is invalid")
	}
	le := binary.LittleEndian
	for count := 0; len(data) > 0; count++ {
		if count >= 32 || len(data) < 16 {
			return errors.New("identity context count or header bound")
		}
		next := le.Uint32(data)
		end := len(data)
		if next != 0 {
			if next < 16 || next&7 != 0 || uint64(next)+16 > uint64(len(data)) {
				return errors.New("identity context next offset is invalid")
			}
			end = int(next)
		}
		nameOffset, nameLength := uint32(le.Uint16(data[4:6])), uint32(le.Uint16(data[6:8]))
		valueOffset, valueLength := uint32(le.Uint16(data[10:12])), le.Uint32(data[12:16])
		name, nameOK := cacheGatePositiveField(data[:end], nameOffset, nameLength, 16)
		value, valueOK := cacheGatePositiveField(data[:end], valueOffset, valueLength, 16)
		if !nameOK || !valueOK || len(name) == 0 || len(name) > 32 || le.Uint16(data[8:10]) != 0 {
			return errors.New("identity context fields are invalid")
		}
		if valueLength != 0 && uint64(nameOffset) < uint64(valueOffset)+uint64(valueLength) && uint64(valueOffset) < uint64(nameOffset)+uint64(nameLength) {
			return errors.New("identity context name overlaps data")
		}
		for at := 16; at < end; at++ {
			if uint64(at) >= uint64(nameOffset) && uint64(at) < uint64(nameOffset)+uint64(nameLength) || valueLength != 0 && uint64(at) >= uint64(valueOffset) && uint64(at) < uint64(valueOffset)+uint64(valueLength) {
				continue
			}
			if data[at] != 0 {
				return errors.New("identity context padding is nonzero")
			}
		}
		out.ContextNames = append(out.ContextNames, hex.EncodeToString(name))
		if string(name) == "QFid" {
			if out.QFidRequested || out.QFid != nil {
				return errors.New("duplicate QFid context")
			}
			if out.Response {
				if len(value) != 32 {
					return errors.New("QFid response length is invalid")
				}
				out.QFid = &preciseQFid{Raw: hex.EncodeToString(value), DiskID: le.Uint64(value), VolumeID: le.Uint64(value[8:]), Reserved: hex.EncodeToString(value[16:])}
			} else {
				if len(value) != 0 {
					return errors.New("QFid request carries data")
				}
				out.QFidRequested = true
			}
		}
		if next == 0 {
			break
		}
		data = data[end:]
	}
	return nil
}
func preciseIdentityCharge(record preciseIdentityRecord) int {
	// The first pending entry can allocate a complete map group in addition to its retained record.
	charge := 4096 + 4*len(record.FileID)
	for _, name := range record.ContextNames {
		charge += 4 * len(name)
	}
	if record.QFid != nil {
		charge += 4 * (len(record.QFid.Raw) + len(record.QFid.Reserved))
	}
	if record.FileIdentity != nil {
		charge += 4 * (len(record.FileIdentity.RawIdentity) + len(record.FileIdentity.ID128))
	}
	return charge
}
func cacheGatePreciseIdentity(packet []byte, r cacheGatePositiveWireRecord) bool {
	if !preciseIdentitySelected(r) {
		return true
	}
	record, err := preciseIdentityFields(packet, r)
	record.Sequence = parentObservationBoundary()
	preciseIdentityRegistry.Lock()
	defer preciseIdentityRegistry.Unlock()
	key := parentNotifyKey{r.Connection, r.MessageID}
	if err == nil && !r.Response && r.RelatedCreate != 0 {
		created, ok := preciseIdentityRegistry.pending[parentNotifyKey{r.Connection, r.RelatedCreate}]
		if !r.related || r.Flags&wire.FlagRelated == 0 || !ok || created.Command != wire.Create || created.Response || created.Session == 0 || created.Session == ^uint64(0) {
			err = errors.New("inherited identity session lacks same-compound CREATE lineage")
		} else {
			record.Session = created.Session
		}
	} else if err == nil && !r.Response && record.Session == ^uint64(0) {
		err = errors.New("inherited identity session has no related CREATE")
	}
	if err == nil && r.Response {
		previous, ok := preciseIdentityRegistry.pending[key]
		if !ok || previous.Command != record.Command || previous.Session != record.Session || previous.QueryType != record.QueryType || previous.QueryClass != record.QueryClass {
			err = errors.New("identity response has no exact owned request")
		} else {
			record.QFidRequested = previous.QFidRequested
			if r.Command == wire.Create && r.Status == 0 && previous.QFidRequested && record.QFid == nil {
				err = errors.New("requested QFid missing from successful CREATE")
			}
			if r.Command == wire.QueryInfo {
				if previous.RelatedCreate == 0 {
					if previous.FileID != record.FileID {
						err = errors.New("identity response changed SMB file handle")
					}
				} else {
					linked := false
					for _, created := range preciseIdentityRegistry.records {
						if created.Response && created.Command == wire.Create && created.Status == 0 && created.Connection == record.Connection && created.Session == record.Session && created.MessageID == previous.RelatedCreate && created.FileID == record.FileID {
							linked = true
						}
					}
					if !linked || record.RelatedCreate != previous.RelatedCreate {
						err = errors.New("related identity response lacks a known CREATE handle")
					}
				}
			}
		}
		delete(preciseIdentityRegistry.pending, key)
	} else if err == nil {
		if _, ok := preciseIdentityRegistry.pending[key]; ok {
			err = errors.New("duplicate identity request")
		}
	}
	if preciseIdentityRegistry.failure != nil {
		return false
	}
	if len(preciseIdentityRegistry.records) >= preciseIdentityRecords || preciseIdentityCharge(record) > preciseIdentityBytes-preciseIdentityRegistry.bytes {
		preciseIdentityRegistry.failure = errors.New("identity evidence retention bound exceeded")
		return false
	}
	if err != nil {
		record.Complete = false
		record.Error = err.Error()
		preciseIdentityRegistry.failure = err
	}
	preciseIdentityRegistry.bytes += preciseIdentityCharge(record)
	preciseIdentityRegistry.records = append(preciseIdentityRegistry.records, record)
	if err == nil && !r.Response {
		preciseIdentityRegistry.pending[key] = record
	}
	return err == nil
}

const preciseRequestedQFid = "requested-only"
const preciseAlwaysQFid = "always-truthful"

func preciseQFidPolicy(value string) (string, error) {
	if value == "" {
		return preciseRequestedQFid, nil
	}
	if value != preciseRequestedQFid && value != preciseAlwaysQFid {
		return "", errors.New("unknown diagnostic QFid response policy")
	}
	return value, nil
}

func preciseIdentityEndFirstOpen() {
	sequence := parentObservationBoundary()
	preciseIdentityRegistry.Lock()
	defer preciseIdentityRegistry.Unlock()
	if preciseIdentityRegistry.firstOpenEnd != 0 {
		preciseIdentityRegistry.failure = errors.Join(preciseIdentityRegistry.failure, errors.New("first-open end was recorded twice"))
		return
	}
	preciseIdentityRegistry.firstOpenEnd = sequence
}

type precisePolicyEvidence struct {
	Policy                                           string
	FirstBegin, FirstEnd                             uint64
	OldRequest, OldResponse, NewRequest, NewResponse *preciseIdentityRecord
	WireSuccess                                      bool
	NativeOpenSucceeded                              bool
	NativeIdentitySucceeded                          bool
	NewNativeDistinct                                bool
	RetainedNativeStable                             bool
	StimulusDelivered                                bool
	NativeOracle                                     string
	Error                                            string
}

func precisePolicyNative(report *parentInvalidationReport) precisePolicyEvidence {
	evidence := precisePolicyEvidence{NativeOracle: report.IdentityResult}
	opened := report.Qualification.Native
	evidence.NativeOpenSucceeded = opened.Error == "" && !opened.Started.IsZero() && !opened.Completed.IsZero() && report.IdentityResult != "replacement_first_open_failed"
	old, current, retained := report.OldIdentity, report.NewIdentity, report.RetainedIdentity
	evidence.NativeIdentitySucceeded = current.Error == "" && current.Identity != 0 && !current.Completed.IsZero()
	evidence.NewNativeDistinct = old.Error == "" && current.Error == "" && old.Identity != 0 && current.Identity != 0 && current.Volume == old.Volume && current.Identity != old.Identity
	evidence.RetainedNativeStable = old.Error == "" && retained.Error == "" && old.Identity != 0 && retained.Identity != 0 && retained.Volume == old.Volume && retained.Identity == old.Identity
	return evidence
}

func preciseContextQFidCount(record preciseIdentityRecord) int {
	count := 0
	for _, name := range record.ContextNames {
		if name == "51466964" {
			count++
		}
	}
	return count
}

func precisePolicyGate(policy string, records []preciseIdentityRecord, wireRecords []cacheGatePositiveWireRecord, report *parentInvalidationReport, end uint64) precisePolicyEvidence {
	result := precisePolicyNative(report)
	result.Policy = policy
	result.FirstBegin = report.FirstObservationSequence
	result.FirstEnd = end
	refuse := func(message string) precisePolicyEvidence { result.Error = message; return result }
	if policy == preciseRequestedQFid {
		return result
	}
	if policy != preciseAlwaysQFid {
		return refuse("unknown QFid evidence policy")
	}
	if result.FirstBegin == 0 || end <= result.FirstBegin {
		return refuse("first CREATE ordinal bracket is absent")
	}
	type ownedPair struct{ request, response *preciseIdentityRecord }
	pairs := make(map[parentNotifyKey]ownedPair)
	var previous uint64
	for i := range records {
		record := &records[i]
		if record.Sequence == 0 || record.Sequence <= previous || !record.Complete || record.Error != "" {
			return refuse("passive identity source order or completeness is invalid")
		}
		previous = record.Sequence
		if record.Command != wire.Create {
			continue
		}
		if !record.Response && (!record.ContextsChecked || preciseContextQFidCount(*record) != map[bool]int{false: 0, true: 1}[record.QFidRequested] || record.QFid != nil) {
			return refuse("CREATE request context absence or presence is unproven")
		}
		key := parentNotifyKey{record.Connection, record.MessageID}
		pair := pairs[key]
		if record.Connection == 0 || record.Session == 0 || record.Session == ^uint64(0) {
			return refuse("CREATE identity lineage is absent")
		}
		if record.Response {
			if pair.request == nil || pair.response != nil || pair.request.Session != record.Session || pair.request.QFidRequested != record.QFidRequested || record.Sequence <= pair.request.Sequence {
				return refuse("CREATE response has ambiguous request ownership")
			}
			pair.response = record
		} else {
			if pair.request != nil {
				return refuse("CREATE request key is reused")
			}
			pair.request = record
		}
		pairs[key] = pair
	}
	// The passive identity callback has no names. Only the original correlated
	// request records establish that a CREATE belongs to the selected target.
	names := make(map[parentNotifyKey]string)
	replies := make(map[parentNotifyKey]bool)
	for _, record := range wireRecords {
		if record.Command != wire.Create {
			continue
		}
		key := parentNotifyKey{record.Connection, record.MessageID}
		if record.Response {
			pair, ok := pairs[key]
			if !ok || pair.response == nil || replies[key] || record.Incomplete != "" || pair.response.Session != record.SessionID || pair.response.Status != record.Status || pair.response.FileID != record.FileID {
				return refuse("parent wire and identity response ownership disagree")
			}
			replies[key] = true
			continue
		}
		if _, exists := names[key]; exists {
			return refuse("parent wire CREATE request is duplicated")
		}
		pair, ok := pairs[key]
		if !ok || pair.request == nil || pair.request.Session != record.SessionID || record.Incomplete != "" {
			return refuse("parent wire and identity request ownership disagree")
		}
		names[key] = record.Name
	}
	for key, pair := range pairs {
		if pair.request == nil || pair.response == nil {
			return refuse("CREATE identity exchange is incomplete")
		}
		if _, ok := names[key]; !ok || !replies[key] {
			return refuse("CREATE identity exchange lacks complete parent wire ownership")
		}
		request, response := pair.request, pair.response
		if request.Sequence > result.FirstBegin && request.Sequence < end && names[key] == `v\target` {
			if result.NewRequest != nil {
				return refuse("first native open issued ambiguous target CREATE requests")
			}
			result.NewRequest = request
			result.NewResponse = response
		}
	}
	if result.NewRequest == nil {
		return refuse("first native open has no bound target CREATE")
	}
	result.WireSuccess = result.NewResponse.Status == 0
	if result.NewRequest.QFidRequested {
		return refuse("selected new CREATE unexpectedly requested QFid")
	}
	for key, pair := range pairs {
		request, response := pair.request, pair.response
		if response.Status != 0 {
			if response.QFid != nil {
				return refuse("failed CREATE acquired a fabricated QFid")
			}
			continue
		}
		if !response.ContextsChecked || preciseContextQFidCount(*response) != 1 || response.QFid == nil || response.FileID == "" || len(response.QFid.Raw) != 64 || len(response.QFid.Reserved) != 32 {
			return refuse("successful CREATE lacks complete QFid payload")
		}
		raw, err := hex.DecodeString(response.QFid.Raw)
		if err != nil || len(raw) != 32 || binary.LittleEndian.Uint64(raw) != response.QFid.DiskID || binary.LittleEndian.Uint64(raw[8:]) != response.QFid.VolumeID || hex.EncodeToString(raw[16:]) != response.QFid.Reserved || response.QFid.Reserved != "00000000000000000000000000000000" {
			return refuse("QFid raw payload disagrees with retained identity fields")
		}
		if request.Sequence < result.FirstBegin && names[key] == `v\target` && response.QFid.DiskID == report.Initial.ID {
			if result.OldRequest != nil {
				return refuse("old target QFid ownership is ambiguous")
			}
			result.OldRequest = request
			result.OldResponse = response
		}
	}
	if !result.WireSuccess {
		return result
	}
	if result.OldRequest == nil || result.OldResponse.Sequence >= result.FirstBegin || result.OldRequest.Connection != result.NewRequest.Connection || result.OldRequest.Session != result.NewRequest.Session || result.OldResponse.FileID == result.NewResponse.FileID {
		return refuse("old and new CREATE identities lack distinct same-session ownership")
	}
	if report.Initial.ID == 0 || report.Expected.ID == 0 || report.Expected.ID == report.Initial.ID || result.NewResponse.QFid.DiskID != report.Expected.ID || result.NewResponse.QFid.VolumeID != result.OldResponse.QFid.VolumeID {
		return refuse("new response QFid is not the captured B and actual A volume tuple")
	}
	result.StimulusDelivered = true
	return result
}

func preciseIdentityAudit(t *testing.T, report *parentInvalidationReport) {
	t.Helper()
	records, err := preciseIdentitySnapshot()
	policy, policyErr := preciseQFidPolicy(os.Getenv("RFS_QFID_POLICY"))
	preciseIdentityRegistry.Lock()
	end := preciseIdentityRegistry.firstOpenEnd
	preciseIdentityRegistry.Unlock()
	evidence := precisePolicyGate(policy, records, report.Wire, report, end)
	err = errors.Join(err, policyErr)
	if evidence.Error != "" {
		err = errors.Join(err, errors.New(evidence.Error))
	}
	if err != nil {
		evidence.StimulusDelivered = false
		t.Error("passive identity evidence:", err)
	}
	data, encodeErr := json.MarshalIndent(struct {
		Records []preciseIdentityRecord
		Policy  precisePolicyEvidence
		Error   string
	}{records, evidence, fmt.Sprint(err)}, "", "  ")
	if encodeErr == nil {
		encodeErr = os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(os.Getenv("RFS_GATE_OUTPUT_ROOT"), "precise-identity.json"), data, 0600)
	}
	if encodeErr != nil {
		t.Error("write passive identity evidence:", encodeErr)
	}
}

func TestNativePreciseReplacement(t *testing.T) {
	if os.Getenv("RFS_PRECISE_VARIANT") != "historical_detail" {
		t.Fatal("precise native cell requires its explicit diagnostic variant")
	}
	policy, err := preciseQFidPolicy(os.Getenv("RFS_QFID_POLICY"))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	name := "share0_app_first_replace_identity_precise"
	if policy == preciseAlwaysQFid {
		name = "share0_app_first_replace_identity_always_qfid"
	}
	t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
		preciseIdentityReset()
		report := &parentInvalidationReport{Kind: "replacement", Name: name, ShareMode: 0, Order: "app_first"}
		parentRunCell(t, report.Name, report.Order, report.ShareMode, true, report)
		if report.RescanRequired || !report.PreciseNotificationProven {
			t.Error("precise replacement requires complete detailed notification")
		}
	})
}

func preciseTestCreate(response bool, names []string, values [][]byte) []byte {
	size, structure, contextOffset := 120, uint16(57), 112
	if response {
		size, structure, contextOffset = 152, 89, 144
	}
	packet := make([]byte, size)
	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(packet[64:], structure)
	if len(names) == 0 {
		return packet
	}
	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(packet[contextOffset:], uint32(size))
	for i, name := range names {
		entry := make([]byte, (24+len(values[i])+7)&^7)
		if i+1 < len(names) {
			binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(entry, uint32(len(entry)))
		}
		binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(entry[4:], 16)
		binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(entry[6:], uint16(len(name)))
		if len(values[i]) > 0 {
			binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(entry[10:], 24)
			binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(entry[12:], uint32(len(values[i])))
		}
		copy(entry[16:], name)
		copy(entry[24:], values[i])
		packet = append(packet, entry...)
	}
	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(packet[contextOffset+4:], uint32(len(packet)-size))
	return packet
}
func preciseTestQuery(data []byte) []byte {
	packet := make([]byte, 72+len(data))
	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(packet[64:], 9)
	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(packet[66:], 72)
	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(packet[68:], uint32(len(data)))
	copy(packet[72:], data)
	return packet
}
func TestPreciseIdentityContexts(t *testing.T) {
	payload := make([]byte, 32)
	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint64(payload, 7)
	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint64(payload[8:], 13)
	r := cacheGatePositiveWireRecord{Connection: 1, SessionID: 2, MessageID: 3, Command: wire.Create, Response: true, FileID: "open"}
	packet := preciseTestCreate(true, []string{"QFid"}, [][]byte{payload})
	out, err := preciseIdentityFields(packet, r)
	if err != nil || out.QFid == nil || out.QFid.DiskID != 7 || out.QFid.VolumeID != 13 || out.QFid.Raw != hex.EncodeToString(payload) || !out.ContextsChecked {
		t.Fatal(out, err)
	}
	empty, err := preciseIdentityFields(preciseTestCreate(true, nil, nil), r)
	if err != nil || empty.QFid != nil || !empty.ContextsChecked {
		t.Fatal("absence became zero identity", empty, err)
	}
	zero, err := preciseIdentityFields(preciseTestCreate(true, []string{"QFid"}, [][]byte{make([]byte, 32)}), r)
	if err != nil || zero.QFid == nil || zero.QFid.DiskID != 0 {
		t.Fatal("zero identity became absence", zero, err)
	}
	tests := []struct {
		name   string
		change func([]byte) []byte
	}{
		{"truncated header", func(p []byte) []byte { return p[:70] }},
		{"context beyond frame", func(p []byte) []byte { binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(p[148:], 9999); return p }},
		{"overlap", func(p []byte) []byte { binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(p[152+10:], 16); return p }},
		{"next misaligned", func(p []byte) []byte { binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(p[152:], 17); return p }},
		{"nonzero padding", func(p []byte) []byte { p[152+20] = 1; return p }},
		{"short QFid", func(p []byte) []byte { return preciseTestCreate(true, []string{"QFid"}, [][]byte{make([]byte, 24)}) }},
		{"duplicate QFid", func(p []byte) []byte {
			return preciseTestCreate(true, []string{"QFid", "QFid"}, [][]byte{payload, payload})
		}},
		{"too many contexts", func(p []byte) []byte {
			names := make([]string, 33)
			values := make([][]byte, 33)
			for i := range names {
				names[i] = "X"
			}
			return preciseTestCreate(true, names, values)
		}},
	}
	for _, test := range tests {
		t.Run(test.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			if _, err := preciseIdentityFields(test.change(slices.Clone(packet)), r); err == nil {
				t.Fatal("malformed identity context accepted")
			}
		})
	}
	r.Response = false
	if _, err := preciseIdentityFields(preciseTestCreate(false, []string{"QFid"}, [][]byte{payload}), r); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("request payload accepted")
	}
	r.Response = true
	r.Status = 0xc0000022
	failed, err := preciseIdentityFields(make([]byte, 72), r)
	if err != nil || failed.QFid != nil || failed.ContextsChecked || failed.Status != r.Status {
		t.Fatal("failed response acquired identity", failed, err)
	}
}
func TestPreciseIdentityQueries(t *testing.T) {
	for _, test := range []struct {
		name        string
		kind, class byte
		size        int
	}{
		{"internal", 1, 6, 8}, {"all", 1, 18, 100}, {"fileid128", 1, 59, 24}, {"volume", 2, 1, 18},
	} {
		t.Run(test.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			r := cacheGatePositiveWireRecord{Connection: 1, SessionID: 2, MessageID: 3, Command: wire.QueryInfo, Response: true, QueryType: test.kind, QueryClass: test.class, FileID: "open"}
			data := make([]byte, test.size)
			out, err := preciseIdentityFields(preciseTestQuery(data), r)
			if err != nil || test.kind == 1 && out.FileIdentity == nil || test.kind == 2 && out.VolumeSerial == nil {
				t.Fatal(out, err)
			}
			if test.class == 6 || test.class == 18 {
				if out.FileIdentity.InternalID == nil || *out.FileIdentity.InternalID != 0 {
					t.Fatal("zero internal ID omitted")
				}
			}
			if test.class == 59 && out.FileIdentity.VolumeID == nil {
				t.Fatal("zero volume ID omitted")
			}
			nonzero := slices.Clone(data)
			switch test.class {
			case 6:
				binary.LittleEndian.PutUint64(nonzero, 0xfedcba9876543210)
			case 18:
				binary.LittleEndian.PutUint64(nonzero[64:], 0xfedcba9876543210)
			case 59:
				binary.LittleEndian.PutUint64(nonzero, 0x123456789)
				binary.LittleEndian.PutUint64(nonzero[8:], 0xfedcba9876543210)
				binary.LittleEndian.PutUint64(nonzero[16:], 0x1122334455667788)
			case 1:
				binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(nonzero[8:], 0x89abcdef)
			}
			value, valueErr := preciseIdentityFields(preciseTestQuery(nonzero), r)
			if valueErr != nil {
				t.Fatal(valueErr)
			}
			if (test.class == 6 || test.class == 18) && *value.FileIdentity.InternalID != 0xfedcba9876543210 {
				t.Fatal("internal ID changed", value)
			}
			if test.class == 59 && (value.FileIdentity.ID128 != hex.EncodeToString(nonzero[8:]) || *value.FileIdentity.VolumeID != 0x123456789) {
				t.Fatal("128-bit identity changed", value)
			}
			if test.kind == 2 && *value.VolumeSerial != 0x89abcdef {
				t.Fatal("volume serial changed", value)
			}
			if _, err := preciseIdentityFields(preciseTestQuery(data[:len(data)-1]), r); err == nil {
				t.Fatal("truncated identity accepted")
			}
			if test.class == 18 {
				binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(data[96:], 2)
				if _, err := preciseIdentityFields(preciseTestQuery(data), r); err == nil {
					t.Fatal("missing name payload accepted")
				}
			}
			if test.kind == 2 {
				binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(data[12:], 2)
				if _, err := preciseIdentityFields(preciseTestQuery(data), r); err == nil {
					t.Fatal("missing volume label accepted")
				}
			}
		})
	}
}
func TestPreciseIdentityCorrelation(t *testing.T) {
	request := cacheGatePositiveWireRecord{Connection: 1, SessionID: 2, MessageID: 3, Command: wire.Create}
	response := request
	response.Response = true
	response.FileID = "open"
	requestPacket := preciseTestCreate(false, []string{"QFid"}, [][]byte{nil})
	responsePacket := preciseTestCreate(true, []string{"QFid"}, [][]byte{make([]byte, 32)})
	preciseIdentityReset()
	if !cacheGatePreciseIdentity(requestPacket, request) || !cacheGatePreciseIdentity(responsePacket, response) {
		t.Fatal("valid passive identity exchange rejected")
	}
	records, err := preciseIdentitySnapshot()
	if err != nil || len(records) != 2 || !records[1].QFidRequested || records[1].QFid == nil {
		t.Fatal(records, err)
	}
	for _, test := range []struct {
		name   string
		change func(*cacheGatePositiveWireRecord, *[]byte)
	}{
		{"wrong session", func(r *cacheGatePositiveWireRecord, p *[]byte) { r.SessionID++ }},
		{"wrong message", func(r *cacheGatePositiveWireRecord, p *[]byte) { r.MessageID++ }},
		{"wrong connection", func(r *cacheGatePositiveWireRecord, p *[]byte) { r.Connection++ }},
		{"missing requested QFid", func(r *cacheGatePositiveWireRecord, p *[]byte) { *p = preciseTestCreate(true, nil, nil) }},
	} {
		t.Run(test.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			preciseIdentityReset()
			if !cacheGatePreciseIdentity(requestPacket, request) {
				t.Fatal("request refused")
			}
			r, p := response, slices.Clone(responsePacket)
			test.change(&r, &p)
			if cacheGatePreciseIdentity(p, r) {
				t.Fatal("unbound identity response accepted")
			}
			if _, err := preciseIdentitySnapshot(); err == nil {
				t.Fatal("missing final audit failure")
			}
		})
	}
	t.Run("unrequested absence is explicit", func(t *testing.T) {
		preciseIdentityReset()
		if !cacheGatePreciseIdentity(preciseTestCreate(false, nil, nil), request) || !cacheGatePreciseIdentity(preciseTestCreate(true, nil, nil), response) {
			t.Fatal("legal absence refused")
		}
		rows, err := preciseIdentitySnapshot()
		if err != nil || rows[1].QFid != nil || rows[1].QFidRequested {
			t.Fatal(rows, err)
		}
	})
	t.Run("unfinished request is not evidence", func(t *testing.T) {
		preciseIdentityReset()
		cacheGatePreciseIdentity(requestPacket, request)
		if _, err := preciseIdentitySnapshot(); err == nil {
			t.Fatal("unfinished request accepted")
		}
	})
	t.Run("bounded capture never truncates to success", func(t *testing.T) {
		preciseIdentityReset()
		for i := 0; i < 100; i++ {
			r := request
			r.MessageID = uint64(i + 1)
			if !cacheGatePreciseIdentity(requestPacket, r) {
				break
			}
		}
		rows, err := preciseIdentitySnapshot()
		if err == nil || len(rows) > preciseIdentityRecords || preciseIdentityRegistry.bytes > preciseIdentityBytes {
			t.Fatal("capture bound lost", len(rows), err)
		}
	})
}

func preciseHistoryAudit(t *testing.T, history *preciseHistory) {
	t.Helper()
	data, err := json.MarshalIndent(history.Evidence(), "", "  ")
	if err == nil {
		err = os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(os.Getenv("RFS_GATE_OUTPUT_ROOT"), "precise-history.json"), data, 0600)
	}
	if err != nil {
		t.Error("write historical proof evidence:", err)
	}
}

func TestPreciseIdentityHandleBinding(t *testing.T) {
	create := cacheGatePositiveWireRecord{Connection: 1, SessionID: 2, MessageID: 3, Command: wire.Create}
	created := create
	created.Response = true
	created.FileID = "known-open"
	query := cacheGatePositiveWireRecord{Connection: 1, SessionID: 2, MessageID: 4, Command: wire.QueryInfo, QueryType: 1, QueryClass: 6, FileID: "known-open"}
	answer := query
	answer.Response = true
	establish := func() {
		preciseIdentityReset()
		if !cacheGatePreciseIdentity(preciseTestCreate(false, nil, nil), create) || !cacheGatePreciseIdentity(preciseTestCreate(true, nil, nil), created) {
			t.Fatal("CREATE binding failed")
		}
	}
	t.Run("identity response binds exact handle", func(t *testing.T) {
		establish()
		if !cacheGatePreciseIdentity(make([]byte, 72), query) || !cacheGatePreciseIdentity(preciseTestQuery(make([]byte, 8)), answer) {
			t.Fatal("known identity handle rejected")
		}
		if _, err := preciseIdentitySnapshot(); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	})
	t.Run("changed identity handle is refused", func(t *testing.T) {
		establish()
		cacheGatePreciseIdentity(make([]byte, 72), query)
		r := answer
		r.FileID = "other-open"
		if cacheGatePreciseIdentity(preciseTestQuery(make([]byte, 8)), r) {
			t.Fatal("different handle accepted")
		}
	})
	t.Run("duplicate request and unsolicited response are refused", func(t *testing.T) {
		preciseIdentityReset()
		cacheGatePreciseIdentity(preciseTestCreate(false, nil, nil), create)
		if cacheGatePreciseIdentity(preciseTestCreate(false, nil, nil), create) {
			t.Fatal("duplicate request accepted")
		}
		preciseIdentityReset()
		if cacheGatePreciseIdentity(preciseTestCreate(true, nil, nil), created) {
			t.Fatal("unsolicited identity response accepted")
		}
	})
	t.Run("nonidentity command adds no observation", func(t *testing.T) {
		preciseIdentityReset()
		r := query
		r.QueryClass = 34
		if !cacheGatePreciseIdentity(nil, r) {
			t.Fatal("unselected traffic refused")
		}
		records, err := preciseIdentitySnapshot()
		if err != nil || len(records) != 0 {
			t.Fatal("unselected traffic became identity", records, err)
		}
	})
}

func preciseRequireDetail(outcome parentNotifyOutcome) error {
	if outcome.Mode != parentDetail || outcome.Detail == nil {
		return errors.New("precise replacement received a rescan or missing detail")
	}
	return nil
}
func TestPreciseNotificationMode(t *testing.T) {
	at := time.Unix(1800000000, 0)
	request := parentNotifyRequest{Key: parentNotifyKey{1, 3}, Session: 2, FileID: "root", Filter: parentNotifyFilter, Recursive: true, Capacity: parentNotifyLimit}
	pending := cacheGatePositiveWireRecord{At: at, Connection: 1, SessionID: 2, MessageID: 3, Command: wire.ChangeNotify, Response: true, FileID: "root", Status: 0x103}
	terminal := pending
	terminal.Status = parentStatusNotifyEnum
	outcome, ready, err := parentMatchNotifyOutcome(request, parentNativeCompletion{Drained: true, Completed: at}, []cacheGatePositiveWireRecord{pending, terminal}, nil)
	if err != nil || !ready || outcome.Mode != parentVerifiedRescan {
		t.Fatal("real typed rescan fixture invalid", outcome, ready, err)
	}
	if preciseRequireDetail(outcome) == nil {
		t.Fatal("verified rescan satisfied precise delivery")
	}
	items := []parentNotifyItem{{2, `v\target`}, {4, `v\replacement`}, {5, `v\target`}}
	terminal.Status = 0
	outcome, ready, err = parentMatchNotifyOutcome(request, parentNativeCompletion{Drained: true, Count: 128, Completed: at, Items: items}, []cacheGatePositiveWireRecord{pending, terminal}, []parentNotifyResult{{Request: request, Items: items, At: at}})
	if err != nil || !ready || preciseRequireDetail(outcome) != nil {
		t.Fatal("real detail refused", outcome, ready, err)
	}
	outcome.Detail = nil
	if preciseRequireDetail(outcome) == nil {
		t.Fatal("mode without actual detail accepted")
	}
}

func TestPreciseIdentityInheritedSession(t *testing.T) {
	for _, test := range []struct {
		name                        string
		rawSession, responseSession uint64
		related                     bool
		valid                       bool
	}{
		{"inherited all-ones", ^uint64(0), 2, true, true},
		{"ignored related raw value", 77, 2, true, true},
		{"wrong CREATE response session", ^uint64(0), 3, true, false},
		{"unrelated session cannot be guessed", ^uint64(0), 2, false, false},
	} {
		t.Run(test.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			preciseIdentityReset()
			cacheGateResetPositiveWire()
			parentNotifyReset()
			observer := cacheGateNewPositiveFrameObserver()
			create := preciseTestCreate(false, nil, nil)
			if err := (wire.Header{Command: wire.Create, MessageID: 3, SessionID: 2, NextCommand: uint32(len(create))}).Encode(create); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			query := make([]byte, 104)
			binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(query[64:], 41)
			query[66], query[67] = 1, 6
			binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(query[68:], 8)
			for i := 88; i < 104; i++ {
				query[i] = 0xff
			}
			flags := uint32(0)
			if test.related {
				flags = wire.FlagRelated
			}
			if err := (wire.Header{Command: wire.QueryInfo, MessageID: 4, SessionID: test.rawSession, Flags: flags}).Encode(query); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			requestFrame := append(create, query...)
			requestOriginal := slices.Clone(requestFrame)
			observer.frame(requestFrame, false)
			if !slices.Equal(requestFrame, requestOriginal) {
				t.Fatal("passive observer changed the compound request")
			}
			created := preciseTestCreate(true, nil, nil)
			created[128] = 9
			if err := (wire.Header{Command: wire.Create, MessageID: 3, SessionID: test.responseSession, Flags: wire.FlagResponse, NextCommand: uint32(len(created))}).Encode(created); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			data := make([]byte, 8)
			binary.LittleEndian.PutUint64(data, 0x1122334455667788)
			response := preciseTestQuery(data)
			if err := (wire.Header{Command: wire.QueryInfo, MessageID: 4, SessionID: 2, Flags: wire.FlagResponse | wire.FlagRelated}).Encode(response); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			responseFrame := append(created, response...)
			responseOriginal := slices.Clone(responseFrame)
			observer.frame(responseFrame, true)
			if !slices.Equal(responseFrame, responseOriginal) {
				t.Fatal("passive observer changed the compound response")
			}
			rows, err := preciseIdentitySnapshot()
			if !test.valid {
				if err == nil && !observer.incomplete {
					t.Fatal("unproven inherited session accepted")
				}
				return
			}
			if err != nil || observer.incomplete || len(rows) != 4 {
				t.Fatal("valid related compound refused", rows, err, observer.incomplete)
			}
			if rows[1].RawSession != test.rawSession || rows[1].Session != 2 || rows[3].Session != 2 || rows[3].FileID != rows[2].FileID || rows[3].FileIdentity == nil || *rows[3].FileIdentity.InternalID != 0x1122334455667788 {
				t.Fatal("identity provenance changed", rows)
			}
		})
	}
}

func precisePolicyFixture() ([]preciseIdentityRecord, []cacheGatePositiveWireRecord, parentInvalidationReport) {
	at := time.Unix(1800000000, 0)
	qfid := func(id uint64) *preciseQFid {
		data := make([]byte, 32)
		binary.LittleEndian.PutUint64(data, id)
		binary.LittleEndian.PutUint64(data[8:], 17)
		return &preciseQFid{Raw: hex.EncodeToString(data), DiskID: id, VolumeID: 17, Reserved: hex.EncodeToString(data[16:])}
	}
	records := []preciseIdentityRecord{
		{Sequence: 1, At: at, Connection: 1, Session: 2, RawSession: 2, MessageID: 3, Command: wire.Create, ContextsChecked: true, ContextNames: []string{"51466964"}, QFidRequested: true, Complete: true},
		{Sequence: 2, At: at, Connection: 1, Session: 2, RawSession: 2, MessageID: 3, Command: wire.Create, Response: true, FileID: "old-A", ContextsChecked: true, ContextNames: []string{"51466964"}, QFidRequested: true, QFid: qfid(3), Complete: true},
		{Sequence: 11, At: at, Connection: 1, Session: 2, RawSession: 2, MessageID: 4, Command: wire.Create, ContextsChecked: true, Complete: true},
		{Sequence: 12, At: at, Connection: 1, Session: 2, RawSession: 2, MessageID: 4, Command: wire.Create, Response: true, FileID: "new-B", ContextsChecked: true, ContextNames: []string{"51466964"}, QFid: qfid(4), Complete: true},
	}
	wireRecords := []cacheGatePositiveWireRecord{{At: at, Connection: 1, SessionID: 2, MessageID: 3, Command: wire.Create, Name: `v\target`}, {At: at, Connection: 1, SessionID: 2, MessageID: 4, Command: wire.Create, Name: `v\target`}}
	for _, record := range records {
		if record.Response {
			wireRecords = append(wireRecords, cacheGatePositiveWireRecord{At: at, Connection: record.Connection, SessionID: record.Session, MessageID: record.MessageID, Command: wire.Create, Response: true, Status: record.Status, FileID: record.FileID})
		}
	}
	report := parentInvalidationReport{FirstObservationSequence: 10, IdentityResult: "distinct_native_identity_and_preserved_bytes"}
	report.Initial.ID = 3
	report.Expected.ID = 4
	report.Qualification.Native = cacheGatePositiveValue{Started: at, Completed: at}
	report.OldIdentity = cacheGatePositiveValue{Started: at, Completed: at, Identity: 3001, Volume: 9, Size: 257}
	report.NewIdentity = cacheGatePositiveValue{Started: at, Completed: at, Identity: 9007, Volume: 9, Size: 769}
	report.RetainedIdentity = report.OldIdentity
	return records, wireRecords, report
}

func TestPreciseQFidPolicy(t *testing.T) {
	for _, value := range []string{"", preciseRequestedQFid, preciseAlwaysQFid} {
		policy, err := preciseQFidPolicy(value)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		expected := value
		if value == "" {
			expected = preciseRequestedQFid
		}
		if policy != expected {
			t.Fatal("policy default changed", policy)
		}
	}
	for _, value := range []string{"always", " requested-only", "ALWAYS-TRUTHFUL"} {
		if _, err := preciseQFidPolicy(value); err == nil {
			t.Fatal("unknown policy accepted", value)
		}
	}
	t.Run("requested-only preserves passive parser contract", func(t *testing.T) {
		_, _, report := precisePolicyFixture()
		result := precisePolicyGate(preciseRequestedQFid, nil, nil, &report, 0)
		if result.Error != "" || result.StimulusDelivered {
			t.Fatal("requested-only acquired unsolicited-response requirements", result)
		}
	})
	t.Run("actual unrequested payload and equal clocks", func(t *testing.T) {
		records, wireRecords, report := precisePolicyFixture()
		result := precisePolicyGate(preciseAlwaysQFid, records, wireRecords, &report, 13)
		if result.Error != "" || !result.WireSuccess || !result.StimulusDelivered || !result.NativeOpenSucceeded || !result.NativeIdentitySucceeded || !result.NewNativeDistinct || !result.RetainedNativeStable || result.NewRequest.QFidRequested {
			t.Fatalf("truthful unsolicited stimulus rejected: %+v", result)
		}
		// FileIndex is opaque and deliberately differs numerically from both NodeIDs.
		if report.NewIdentity.Identity == result.NewResponse.QFid.DiskID {
			t.Fatal("fixture failed to separate native and wire identities")
		}
	})
}

func TestPreciseQFidPolicyRefusals(t *testing.T) {
	cases := []struct {
		name   string
		change func(*[]preciseIdentityRecord, *[]cacheGatePositiveWireRecord, *parentInvalidationReport, *uint64)
	}{
		{"requested-only negative control", func(r *[]preciseIdentityRecord, _ *[]cacheGatePositiveWireRecord, _ *parentInvalidationReport, _ *uint64) {
			(*r)[3].QFid = nil
			(*r)[3].ContextNames = nil
		}},
		{"new request unexpectedly requests QFid", func(r *[]preciseIdentityRecord, _ *[]cacheGatePositiveWireRecord, _ *parentInvalidationReport, _ *uint64) {
			(*r)[2].QFidRequested = true
			(*r)[2].ContextNames = []string{"51466964"}
			(*r)[3].QFidRequested = true
		}},
		{"request absence unchecked", func(r *[]preciseIdentityRecord, _ *[]cacheGatePositiveWireRecord, _ *parentInvalidationReport, _ *uint64) {
			(*r)[2].ContextsChecked = false
		}},
		{"request absence contradicts raw names", func(r *[]preciseIdentityRecord, _ *[]cacheGatePositiveWireRecord, _ *parentInvalidationReport, _ *uint64) {
			(*r)[2].ContextNames = []string{"51466964"}
		}},
		{"old response missing QFid", func(r *[]preciseIdentityRecord, _ *[]cacheGatePositiveWireRecord, _ *parentInvalidationReport, _ *uint64) {
			(*r)[1].QFid = nil
		}},
		{"duplicate response QFid", func(r *[]preciseIdentityRecord, _ *[]cacheGatePositiveWireRecord, _ *parentInvalidationReport, _ *uint64) {
			(*r)[3].ContextNames = append((*r)[3].ContextNames, "51466964")
		}},
		{"wrong new disk identity", func(r *[]preciseIdentityRecord, _ *[]cacheGatePositiveWireRecord, _ *parentInvalidationReport, _ *uint64) {
			(*r)[3].QFid = (*r)[1].QFid
		}},
		{"wrong volume", func(r *[]preciseIdentityRecord, _ *[]cacheGatePositiveWireRecord, _ *parentInvalidationReport, _ *uint64) {
			(*r)[3].QFid.VolumeID++
		}},
		{"forged parsed ID", func(r *[]preciseIdentityRecord, _ *[]cacheGatePositiveWireRecord, _ *parentInvalidationReport, _ *uint64) {
			(*r)[3].QFid.DiskID++
		}},
		{"missing response", func(r *[]preciseIdentityRecord, _ *[]cacheGatePositiveWireRecord, _ *parentInvalidationReport, _ *uint64) {
			*r = (*r)[:3]
		}},
		{"duplicate response", func(r *[]preciseIdentityRecord, _ *[]cacheGatePositiveWireRecord, _ *parentInvalidationReport, _ *uint64) {
			copy := (*r)[3]
			copy.Sequence = 14
			*r = append(*r, copy)
		}},
		{"response wrong session", func(r *[]preciseIdentityRecord, _ *[]cacheGatePositiveWireRecord, _ *parentInvalidationReport, _ *uint64) {
			(*r)[3].Session++
		}},
		{"response wrong key", func(r *[]preciseIdentityRecord, _ *[]cacheGatePositiveWireRecord, _ *parentInvalidationReport, _ *uint64) {
			(*r)[3].MessageID++
		}},
		{"same old/new SMB handle", func(r *[]preciseIdentityRecord, _ *[]cacheGatePositiveWireRecord, _ *parentInvalidationReport, _ *uint64) {
			(*r)[3].FileID = (*r)[1].FileID
		}},
		{"old identity is unbound", func(r *[]preciseIdentityRecord, _ *[]cacheGatePositiveWireRecord, _ *parentInvalidationReport, _ *uint64) {
			(*r)[1].QFid = (*r)[3].QFid
		}},
		{"new wire path mismatch", func(_ *[]preciseIdentityRecord, w *[]cacheGatePositiveWireRecord, _ *parentInvalidationReport, _ *uint64) {
			(*w)[1].Name = `v\replacement`
		}},
		{"wire key mismatch", func(_ *[]preciseIdentityRecord, w *[]cacheGatePositiveWireRecord, _ *parentInvalidationReport, _ *uint64) {
			(*w)[1].MessageID++
		}},
		{"wire session mismatch", func(_ *[]preciseIdentityRecord, w *[]cacheGatePositiveWireRecord, _ *parentInvalidationReport, _ *uint64) {
			(*w)[1].SessionID++
		}},
		{"wire request duplicate", func(_ *[]preciseIdentityRecord, w *[]cacheGatePositiveWireRecord, _ *parentInvalidationReport, _ *uint64) {
			*w = append(*w, (*w)[1])
		}},
		{"missing end ordinal", func(_ *[]preciseIdentityRecord, _ *[]cacheGatePositiveWireRecord, _ *parentInvalidationReport, end *uint64) {
			*end = 0
		}},
		{"at begin ordinal", func(r *[]preciseIdentityRecord, _ *[]cacheGatePositiveWireRecord, _ *parentInvalidationReport, _ *uint64) {
			(*r)[2].Sequence = 10
		}},
		{"at end ordinal", func(_ *[]preciseIdentityRecord, _ *[]cacheGatePositiveWireRecord, _ *parentInvalidationReport, end *uint64) {
			*end = 11
		}},
		{"out of order ordinal", func(r *[]preciseIdentityRecord, _ *[]cacheGatePositiveWireRecord, _ *parentInvalidationReport, _ *uint64) {
			(*r)[3].Sequence = 11
		}},
		{"unknown current B", func(_ *[]preciseIdentityRecord, _ *[]cacheGatePositiveWireRecord, r *parentInvalidationReport, _ *uint64) {
			r.Expected.ID = 0
		}},
	}
	for _, tc := range cases {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			records, wireRecords, report := precisePolicyFixture()
			end := uint64(13)
			tc.change(&records, &wireRecords, &report, &end)
			result := precisePolicyGate(preciseAlwaysQFid, records, wireRecords, &report, end)
			if result.Error == "" || result.StimulusDelivered {
				t.Fatalf("unqualified stimulus admitted: %+v", result)
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestPreciseQFidOutcomeSeparation(t *testing.T) {
	for _, mode := range []string{"distinct handles", "both old identity", "old handle overwritten", "server rejected CREATE", "native open rejected", "native identity rejected"} {
		t.Run(mode, func(t *testing.T) {
			records, wireRecords, report := precisePolicyFixture()
			before, after := make([]byte, 257), make([]byte, 769)
			report.RetainedRead = cacheGatePositiveValue{Count: 257, Digest: cacheGatePositiveDigest(before)}
			report.NewRead = cacheGatePositiveValue{Count: 769, Digest: cacheGatePositiveDigest(after)}
			switch mode {
			case "both old identity":
				report.NewIdentity.Identity = report.OldIdentity.Identity
			case "old handle overwritten":
				report.RetainedIdentity.Identity = report.NewIdentity.Identity
			case "server rejected CREATE":
				records[3].Status = 0xc000000d
				records[3].QFid = nil
				records[3].ContextNames = nil
				records[3].ContextsChecked = false
				records[3].FileID = ""
				wireRecords[3].Status = records[3].Status
				wireRecords[3].FileID = ""
				report.Qualification.Native.Error = "CreateFile failed"
				report.NewIdentity = cacheGatePositiveValue{}
				report.RetainedIdentity = cacheGatePositiveValue{}
			case "native open rejected":
				report.Qualification.Native.Error = "CreateFile failed"
				report.NewIdentity = cacheGatePositiveValue{}
				report.RetainedIdentity = cacheGatePositiveValue{}
			case "native identity rejected":
				report.NewIdentity.Error = "GetFileInformationByHandle failed"
				report.NewIdentity.Identity = 0
			}
			report.IdentityResult = parentRelativeIdentity(report.OldIdentity, report.NewIdentity, report.RetainedIdentity, report.RetainedRead, report.NewRead, before, after)
			if mode == "server rejected CREATE" || mode == "native open rejected" {
				report.IdentityResult = "replacement_first_open_failed"
			}
			result := precisePolicyGate(preciseAlwaysQFid, records, wireRecords, &report, 13)
			if result.Error != "" {
				t.Fatal(result.Error)
			}
			if result.NativeOracle != report.IdentityResult {
				t.Fatal("native oracle rewritten")
			}
			switch mode {
			case "distinct handles":
				if !result.WireSuccess || !result.StimulusDelivered || !result.NewNativeDistinct || !result.RetainedNativeStable || result.NativeOracle != "distinct_native_identity_and_preserved_bytes" {
					t.Fatal(result)
				}
			case "both old identity":
				if !result.StimulusDelivered || result.NewNativeDistinct || !result.RetainedNativeStable || result.NativeOracle != "replacement_identity_aliased" {
					t.Fatal(result)
				}
			case "old handle overwritten":
				if !result.StimulusDelivered || !result.NewNativeDistinct || result.RetainedNativeStable || result.NativeOracle != "retained_identity_changed" {
					t.Fatal(result)
				}
			case "server rejected CREATE":
				if result.WireSuccess || result.StimulusDelivered || result.NativeOpenSucceeded || result.NativeIdentitySucceeded || result.NewResponse.Status != 0xc000000d {
					t.Fatal(result)
				}
			case "native open rejected":
				if !result.WireSuccess || !result.StimulusDelivered || result.NativeOpenSucceeded || result.NativeIdentitySucceeded {
					t.Fatal(result)
				}
			case "native identity rejected":
				if !result.WireSuccess || !result.StimulusDelivered || !result.NativeOpenSucceeded || result.NativeIdentitySucceeded || result.NewNativeDistinct || result.NativeOracle != "identity_unavailable" {
					t.Fatal(result)
				}
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestPreciseQFidAmbiguousAndOtherCreates(t *testing.T) {
	for _, mode := range []string{"ambiguous new", "ambiguous old", "other successful CREATE lacks QFid", "different connection", "failed CREATE with fabricated identity"} {
		t.Run(mode, func(t *testing.T) {
			records, wireRecords, report := precisePolicyFixture()
			end := uint64(20)
			switch mode {
			case "ambiguous new":
				request, response := records[2], records[3]
				request.MessageID = 5
				response.MessageID = 5
				request.Sequence = 13
				response.Sequence = 14
				response.FileID = "second-new"
				records = append(records, request, response)
				copy := wireRecords[1]
				copy.MessageID = 5
				wireRecords = append(wireRecords, copy)
			case "ambiguous old":
				request, response := records[0], records[1]
				request.MessageID = 5
				response.MessageID = 5
				request.Sequence = 3
				response.Sequence = 4
				response.FileID = "second-old"
				records = append(append(slices.Clone(records[:2]), request, response), records[2:]...)
				copy := wireRecords[0]
				copy.MessageID = 5
				wireRecords = append(wireRecords, copy)
			case "other successful CREATE lacks QFid":
				request, response := records[2], records[3]
				request.MessageID = 5
				response.MessageID = 5
				request.Sequence = 13
				response.Sequence = 14
				response.FileID = "other"
				response.QFid = nil
				response.ContextNames = nil
				records = append(records, request, response)
				copy := wireRecords[1]
				copy.MessageID = 5
				copy.Name = "v"
				wireRecords = append(wireRecords, copy)
			case "different connection":
				records[2].Connection = 2
				records[3].Connection = 2
				wireRecords[1].Connection = 2
			case "failed CREATE with fabricated identity":
				records[3].Status = 0xc000000d
			}
			for _, record := range records {
				if record.Response && record.MessageID == 5 {
					wireRecords = append(wireRecords, cacheGatePositiveWireRecord{Connection: record.Connection, SessionID: record.Session, MessageID: record.MessageID, Command: wire.Create, Response: true, Status: record.Status, FileID: record.FileID})
				}
			}
			if mode == "different connection" {
				wireRecords[3].Connection = 2
			}
			if mode == "failed CREATE with fabricated identity" {
				wireRecords[3].Status = records[3].Status
			}
			result := precisePolicyGate(preciseAlwaysQFid, records, wireRecords, &report, end)
			if result.Error == "" || result.StimulusDelivered {
				t.Fatalf("ambiguous or incomplete policy evidence accepted: %+v", result)
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestPreciseFirstOpenEndOrdinal(t *testing.T) {
	preciseIdentityReset()
	before := parentObservationBoundary()
	preciseIdentityEndFirstOpen()
	preciseIdentityRegistry.Lock()
	end := preciseIdentityRegistry.firstOpenEnd
	preciseIdentityRegistry.Unlock()
	if end <= before {
		t.Fatal("end boundary did not advance source order")
	}
	preciseIdentityEndFirstOpen()
	if _, err := preciseIdentitySnapshot(); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("duplicate end boundary accepted")
	}
	preciseIdentityReset()
	preciseIdentityRegistry.Lock()
	defer preciseIdentityRegistry.Unlock()
	if preciseIdentityRegistry.firstOpenEnd != 0 {
		t.Fatal("first-open bracket leaked to a later fixture")
	}
}
